extensionName.description: Name of the extension, shown in Firefox UI and as the editor page heading.

extensionDescription.message: Find and replace bookmark names, folder names, and URLs. Regular expressions, preview, undo.
extensionDescription.description: Description shown in add-on manager and about pages.

allBookmarks.description: Root entry of the folder scope tree, matching Firefox Library wording.

folderTreeLabel.description: Accessible name of the folder scope tree.

scopeLabel.description: Label before the selected scope folder path.

includeSubfolders.description: Checkbox: search inside subfolders of the selected scope.

tabNames.description: Tab searching bookmark names and folder names.

findLabel.description: Label of the search text field.

replaceLabel.description: Label of the replacement text field.

regexLabel.description: Checkbox: treat Find as a regular expression.

wholeWordLabel.description: Checkbox (literal mode only): match whole words only.

includeFolderNames.description: Checkbox on the Names tab: also rename folders that match.

removeEmoji.description: Button: fills the search form with the emoji pattern.

invalidRegex.description: Prefix of the error shown when the Find pattern does not compile.

summary.description: Preview summary. Placeholders: 1 = applicable changes, 2 = excluded invalid results.

noChanges.description: Summary when the search finds nothing to change.

applyButton.description: Batch apply button. Placeholder: number of checked changes.

applyNone.description: Batch apply button before any changes are computed.

applyOne.description: Button applying a single preview row.

includeRow.description: Accessible name of a preview row's include checkbox.

colCurrent.description: Preview table column: the current value.

colNew.description: Preview table column: the proposed value.

selectAllRows.description: Accessible name of the preview table header checkbox.

applyHint.description: Tooltip of the batch apply button.

keyboardHint.message: Enter updates the preview. Ctrl+Enter applies the checked changes.
keyboardHint.description: Hint line shown below the search form.

invalid-url.description: Problem reason: the proposed URL cannot be parsed.

empty-url.description: Problem reason: the proposed URL is empty.

empty-name.description: Problem reason: the proposed name is empty.

toggleSidebar.message: Show or hide the folder panel
toggleSidebar.description: Tooltip of the sidebar toggle button.

resizeSidebar.message: Drag to resize the folder panel
resizeSidebar.description: Tooltip of the sidebar resize handle.

loadError.description: Prefix of the error banner shown when reading the bookmark tree fails.

retry.description: Button that re-attempts loading the bookmark tree.
